spec.name: Training-free backlog screen
spec.scope: Class-word cross-attention from frozen SD 1.5 plus its native self-attention only. No optimized token, token optimization, LoRA, learned segmentation model, or external segmenter.

datasets.transfer: COCO-Cap, 707 images, settings and thresholds frozen on VOC-Sim

input.ca: frozen C/R class-word seed from configs/controlled_sa_seed_frozen.json
input.sa: module 15, 64x64, all 31 calls and all 8 heads, conditional QK softmax

P9.representative: last sorted SA module at each resolution

W2.ranking: Pearson correlation between c and each head's call-mean A_i c

H1.representative: last sorted SA module at each resolution

G1.note: official DiffSeg merging applied to the frozen-pair mean SA graph; regions are labelled by mean reference score

C1_C2.reason: uses VOC labels for per-class selection and is therefore excluded from the label-free promoted pipeline

excluded.X1: SAM is an externally trained segmenter
excluded.Q7: external-method reproduction is outside this backlog screen
excluded.SG2: owned by Claude's separately registered protocol Section 81 package
excluded.SG4_G2_G3: Claude's Section 81 SG4 package already runs row and spectral partitions; this package keeps only the distinct G1, G4, M1 and M2 segment families
excluded.SG6_SG7: not registered Track-A backlog rows; SG7 also lacks competing class concepts in single-class prompts

spec.selection: Each family is independently cross-validated against REF on VOC-Sim; method parameter and threshold are selected inside each training fold; promotion requires the existing 4/5 vote and OOF guard.
spec.storage: Only resumable confusion-count/AP shards and compact final summaries. Generated images, CA maps, SA maps, Q/K tensors, graphs, clusters, and masks are discarded after every image.
